subject: XXH_ASSUME macro using `__builtin_assume` if supported (clang only for now).
perf_evidence: Commit uses a compiler assumption intrinsic to improve Clang optimization of internal bounds.
change_summary: Selects Clang __builtin_assume in XXH_ASSUME, changing generated optimization assumptions.

units.name: raw XXH3 short-input helper length classes
units.evidence: Four short-input helper targets pass Alive2 in both directions.

units.name: public XXH32/XXH64/XXH3 fixed-length matrix
units.evidence: Short XXH32/XXH64/XXH3 public cases pass in r_api; value-input reruns resolve the two fixed long-case timeouts.

units.name: longer and arbitrary-length paths affected by assumptions
units.evidence: The initial XXH32 length-20 and XXH3 length-200 pointer-input targets time out. Value-input reruns prove those selected fixed instances, but do not settle arbitrary lengths or every assumption site.

notes: A non-target helper in r_api2 reports unsupported noalias; target-level fixed-instance proofs remain valid only where the changed body is visible. The macro's full set of callers and GCC behavior are not proved.
